subject: [COMPANY] / Encord - catch up
text:
Hi [NAME],

[SENDER] mentioned you two connected last year, and I thought I'd be a good
time to reconnect. Would love to hear how [COMPANY]'s AI roadmap has evolved
since then. We're big fans of the work you're doing.

From our side, we've also made some exciting updates to our products since
you last chatted.

Just to recap on Encord: we're a data development platform (curation,
annotation, QA, workflow mgmt & model evaluation). Companies like Zeitview,
UVeye, and intenseye turn to us when their real-world training data grows
too complex for manual processing/traditional annotation tools like CVAT or
Label Studio. And we help by providing native video annotation pipelines
with automation + HITL review.

Would love to see if there's any updates regarding tooling investment.
[SENDER] is traveling to America in the upcoming weeks. Maybe we can catch up
in the first week of Oct?

subject: Scaling [COMPANY]'s ML pipeline
text:
Hi [NAME],

Thought our upcoming session on AI-powered smart city infrastructure could be interesting for [COMPANY].

On 4pm BST, 30th September, Friedrich Münke, Director of Data Science at vialytics, will share his experience scaling ML pipeline to power the future of smart cities.

In this practical 45-minute session, you'll get a behind-the-scenes look at how vialytics:
Unified a fragmented ML pipeline into a single scalable data layer. Tripled dataset sizes and increased data diversity to improve model performance. Applied human-in-the-loop systems to enhance label quality and tackle rare edge cases. Whether you're scaling your own ML pipelines or looking to improve data workflows, this session is packed with real-world lessons you can bring to your next team meeting.

More about the webinar here: [LINK]

subject: Security Systems News + Stop more crimes + Encord
text:
Hi [NAME],

I was reading your interview in Security Systems News, your point on
education being the biggest barrier to AI adoption in physical security
really struck a chord.

The real reason for my outreach is to chat about Pro-Vigil's AI roadmap. We
connected with your team earlier this year and understood that you guys are
currently using manual annotation workflows. Curious if your roadmap has
evolved since then.

If you are like many of the other leaders we work with (LVT, Voxel, Flock
Safety, and Rhombus Systems), you probably face challenges when your
real-world training data grows too complex for manual processes. That's
where we come in to help: providing native video annotation pipelines with
automation + HITL review.

Not sure how familiar you are with Encord: we're a data development
platform for advanced computer vision and multimodal AI (images, sequences,
videos, etc). We bring curation, annotation, workflow mgmt, QA & model
evaluation into one place. So teams can iterate faster and focus on
building better models to stop more crimes.

If you're up for a chat about this and to hear more, I'd be happy to send
an invite along accordingly.

subject: Auto Dealer Today + image authentication + Encord
text:
Hi [NAME],

I just read your piece in *Auto Dealer Today*, impressive how [COMPANY]
flagged ~10% of false claims. Given that, I imagine one of the challenges
for [COMPANY] is keeping model performance sharp across edge cases like
spoofed or tampered images, metadata issues or reused visuals.

That's exactly what we've been helping inspection & authentication teams
like Intenseye, UVeye and Tractable with. We streamline high-volume
multi-modal annotation (docs, images, videos), automated QA + HITL review,
so margin for errors shrink and iteration accelerates.

Some context on Encord: we're a data development platform built for
advanced computer vision and AI teams across industries. We're ~5 yrs old,
100+ employees, and raised $50M+ in funding.

Do you have time over the next week or two to learn more about what your
peers are up to?

Let me know what works for you, and I'll send a calendar invite along
accordingly.

Have a nice weekend!

subject: Riverside-backed + revenue transformation + Encord
text:
Hi [NAME],

I came across your background while researching surveillance innovation and
was struck by your track record - two exits totaling nearly $2B and
multiple revenue transformations across Riverside-backed companies before
stepping into the CEO seat at Pro-Vigil. The blend of board-level
strategy and operational execution you've led is impressive.

The reason I'm reaching out is that we previously connected with your team
and understood that Pro-Vigil is still running largely manual annotation
workflows. From my work with leaders in your space (LVT, Voxel, Flock
Safety & Rhombus Systems), I've seen how that setup quickly becomes a drag
on scaling AI as datasets and customer demands expand.

That's where Encord fits in. We're a data development platform,
purpose-built for computer vision and multi-modal AI. By combining
curation, annotation, QA, workflow mgmt, and model evaluation, we help
surveillance leaders move away from manual bottlenecks and accelerate both
model iteration and revenue growth.

Would love to learn if Pro-Vigil's AI roadmap has evolved since then and
share what your peers are up to.

Let me know if you're open to exploring smarter tooling investment, I'd be
happy to find a time whenever is convenient for you.

subject: partnership with [COMPANY]
text:
Hi [NAME],

Congrats on the feature of MR-1 at the Volkswagen exhibition - a huge
milestone for fenceless industrial robotics & flexible automation!

A pattern we see with robotics teams: as training datasets grow, internal
workflows and annotation setups often struggle to keep up with complex edge
cases and multimodal data. That slows iteration, time to production, and
can affect model performance. We've helped teams like Osaro, Pickle Robot,
and Rapid Robotics scale their data pipeline - from multimodal curation
(sensor/vision data) to edge-case annotation, active learning + HITL
review. So they can move faster without compromising quality.

Quick context on Encord: we're a data development platform for advanced CV,
combining annotation, QA, workflow mgmt, and model evaluation in one place.
The result: teams automate data pipelines and free up engineers to focus on
improving models.

Would you be open to a quick chat in the next week or two to see if this
could support your roadmap? I'm flexible Tuesday to Thursdays and happy to
work around your schedule.

Hi [NAME],

Congrats on the Komatsu partnership! Exciting to see [COMPANY]
advancing autonomous, sustainable mining.

Wanted to reach out since we work with teams at Woven by Toyota, Dyna
Robotics, and Boston Dynamics on similar CV projects like terrain mapping,
object detection, and autonomous navigation. As training datasets grow in
volume and complexity, we help them streamline native video annotation,
active learning, and HITL review to maintain model accuracy & speed up
iteration.

Quick context: Encord is a data development platform for advanced CV and
multimodal AI (images, videos, LiDAR etc), combining data annotation, QA,
and workflow management, so teams can focus on improving model performance.

Given your background and expertise in tactical AI, hybrid machine learning
and AV/ADAS,  I'd love to get your candid feedback on what we've built. Let
me know if you're open for a quick chat Tuesday to Friday next couple of
weeks?
